en.title: Erdoğan to address the world at UN General Assembly, will be the voice of global conscience
en.summary: President Erdoğan traveled to New York to attend the UN General Assembly and will deliver a speech tomorrow. His address is expected to focus on global issues including Palestinian matters, consistent with his previous statements.

en.summary: Anahtar Party leader Yavuz Ağıralioğlu stated that his party is prepared for upcoming elections, with sources indicating they could occur in April 2028 or potentially earlier.

en.summary: President Erdoğan arrived in New York to attend the 81st UN General Assembly, with diplomatic meetings scheduled for September 20-23.

en.title: Yavuz Ağıralioğlu: 'We are ready for elections, we will revive this country in 2-3 years'
en.summary: Anahtar Party leader Ağıralioğlu expressed readiness for elections expected in April 2028 or sooner, stating his party with 800 local organizations could rebuild the country within 2-3 years if elected.

en.title: 5.0 magnitude earthquake in Adana
en.summary: A 5.0 magnitude earthquake occurred in Saimbeyli district of Adana and was felt in surrounding provinces. Authorities reported no negative impacts detected so far, with field surveys still ongoing.

stories.title: Japon yeni için müdahale alarmı: Faiz artışı yetmedi

en.title: Intervention alarm for Japanese yen: Interest rate increase was not enough
en.summary: Japan's central bank raised interest rates to a 31-year high, but the yen continues to face downward pressure. After the currency lost 2 percent value last week, officials' request for exchange rate quotes from banks has revived the possibility of direct market intervention.

stories.title: Petrol fiyatları geriledi, Hürmüz'de gemi trafiği sert düştü

en.title: Oil prices declined, ship traffic in Hormuz dropped sharply
en.summary: Oil prices started the week lower amid diplomatic expectations while commercial vessel traffic through the Strait of Hormuz weakened noticeably. Markets are pricing in potential U.S.-Iran contacts, though shipping movements suggest supply risks remain.

stories.title: Altın fiyatlarında yeni denklem: Fed, Çin ve petrol neyi değiştirecek?

en.title: New equation in gold prices: What will the Fed, China and oil change?
en.summary: Gold entered the new week below 4,400 dollars while facing pressure from four simultaneous forces. The Federal Reserve's firmer rate stance and oil-driven inflation create downward risks, while geopolitical tension and central bank purchases provide support.

en.summary: Turkey's Capital Markets Board decided to extend the liquidation period for funds under liquidation from 3 months to 6 months.
